sources.scope: Only Selectel-demonstrated fields establish support. Upstream AWS optional fields/operations are not assumed Selectel-supported.

request.auth: S3SigV4 explicit project-bound S3 material, service logs, selected pool
request.validation: Required validated names; exact group/stream kind, scope, generation and endpoint; streams require explicit group parent. Event timestamps exact nonnegative int64 milliseconds, ordered; 1..10000 events, <=1048576 UTF8 message bytes+26/event, <=24h batch span. No sorting, splitting, auto-creation or replay. Message revealed only at wire encoding. No wall-clock age/retention inference; provider returns rejection indexes.

response.acknowledgement: Receipt Accepted means positive HTTP acknowledgement, not readiness/ownership or ingestion of every event. Put response preserves typed rejection indexes and protected sequence token; token never drives replay. No Complete=true claim. Create/Delete accept the documented empty HTTP200 body or an empty-compatible JSON object; Put requires a JSON object. Rejection indexes must be within the submitted batch.
response.identity: Created group/stream exact submitted names are locators, not ownership proof. Stream parent is caller group. Unknown creation has no decoded new ref; never discovers/adopts by name.

errors.shape: CloudWatch __type or code, optional namespace# suffix, static known code mappings; raw messages/tokens discarded
errors.5xx: provider_error; mutation outcome unknown when not conclusively rejected
errors.accepted_malformed_body: protocol_error with Accepted Receipt and trustworthy refs retained

cloudwatch_subtypes.LimitExceededException: rate_limited (resource quota, not proof of transient retryability)

replay: Mutations execute once; unknown retains Receipt and exact submitted refs, no retry/signature-token repair, no name lookup or adoption. Caller chooses any next action.
recovery: No automated recovery or readiness/wait goal. Existing ResourceRefs are exact observation locators only. Receipt recovery=resource is core classification, not a supported Resume/ownership assertion.
pagination: Not a collection/stream API; exactly one bounded batch. Shared CallTimeout/MaxJSONBytes apply.
retention: No public retention operation confirmed by Selectel page; panel workflow is not API proof. Existing four read bindings remain partial; inventory incomplete.
